risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine without model/year verification, which may be significantly lower than a verified 1NR from a 2020 Corolla.

risks.risk: Engine may have hidden damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., internal wear, cracked block, worn bearings)

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-running or unknown-condition engine, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Engine may be stolen or salvaged without proper documentation
